description: This file contains functions and types for resolving secret input strings from configuration, including handling fallbacks and unresolved references, within an OpenClaw project.

methods.name: trimToUndefined
methods.description: Trims a string value or returns undefined if not a string or empty.

methods.name: buildUnresolvedReason
methods.description: Builds an error message based on the resolution status of a secret reference.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredSecretInputString
methods.description: Resolves a secret input string, handling unresolved references and trimming.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredSecretInputWithFallback
methods.description: Resolves a secret input string with fallback options if unresolved.

methods.name: resolveRequiredConfiguredSecretRefInputString
methods.description: Resolves a secret input string and throws an error if unresolved.
